children: An address identified as 0xBA2…aB9ff accumulated 740,000 LINK and 3,046.68 ETH over the past five days, spending a total of $15.15 million. According to Odaily, blockchain analyst Ai Yi tracked the address, which now holds 787,000 LINK. After adding to its position, the address’s cost basis fell to about $11.24 per LINK, leaving it with an unrealized loss of $366,000.

title: Address Spends $15.15 Million to Accumulate 740,000 LINK and 3,046.68 ETH in Five Days
